country_event = {
	id = jxp_companies.900
	title = none
	desc = none
	picture = MERCHANTS_TALKING_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		jxp_a_company_pulse_relevant_trigger = yes
	}
	immediate = {
		jxp_a_company_annual_pulse_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				jxp_a_company_has_at_least_1_trigger = yes
				num_of_loans = 5
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_distress_relief }
			}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_chartered
				NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_mining_state_distressed }
			}
			jxp_a_distress_company_mining_effect = yes
			country_event = { id = jxp_companies.401 days = 15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_chartered
				NOT = { has_country_flag = jxp_a_company_shipping_state_distressed }
			}
			jxp_a_distress_company_shipping_effect = yes

		}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				jxp_a_company_has_at_least_1_trigger = yes
				NOT = { has_country_modifier = jxp_a_company_event_cooldown }
			}
			add_country_modifier = { name = jxp_a_company_event_cooldown duration = 1460 }

				1 = { country_event = { id = jxp_companies.31 days = 30 } }
